message: No explicit 'clean' script in package.json — inferred rm -rf dist node_modules as the clean behavior from build output directory and standard npm conventions.
No explicit 'boot' script in package.json — inferred npm ci as the boot command from package-lock.json presence and verification.yml install step.
Lint verb combines three separate checks (eslint, prettier, typecheck) — inferred from verification.yml listing them as separate steps that all belong to code quality.

harness boot (npm ci) fails: package-lock.json out of sync with package.json (missing/invalid transitive @emnapi/* optional deps). Used 'npm install' to sync the lockfile so node_modules could be installed for the verification gate.

harness test/verify wrap 'npm test' (vitest run WITHOUT --coverage), so the >=80% coverage gate required by issue #6 AC/TP-14 is NOT enforced by the harness. Verified separately via 'npm run test:coverage' (now green: 85.7/85.4/82.4/85.7). Baseline test:coverage was pre-existing red (70/79/65/70).
